# ledger_merchant_sources (Data Source)

The sources Ledger can use to look merchants up, with what each one sends off the machine, so an operator can see what is enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What each merchant lookup source sends off the machine, if enabled.
data "ledger_merchant_sources" "all" {}

output "enabled_sources" {
  value = [for s in data.ledger_merchant_sources.all.sources : s.name if s.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sources` (Attributes List) The sources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `attribution` (String) Attribution text the source requires, or null.
- `description` (String) What it does.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `kind` (String) local or remote.
- `name` (String) The source name.
- `retention_hours` (Number) How long results are kept, or null.
- `sends_off_machine` (List of String) What leaves the machine when it is used.
- `stores_logo_ref` (Boolean) Whether a logo reference is stored.
